title: Implement MCP candidate and publication tooling
description:
Exact pack/smoke/attestation and post-tag direct OIDC publication are fixture-tested before freeze without packing or publishing v1.0.0.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Package metadata identifies the repository, license files, executable, and v1.0.0 version; producer definitions accept only the candidate envelope, pass identity preflight before npm test/pack, capture exactly one npm pack --json output, and smoke the installed tarball through initialize/tools-list.
- [hard] REQ-02: The pure publication script/interface accepts an already-authenticated escrow tarball path plus expected integrity/package/tag/provenance identity, uses no NODE_AUTH_TOKEN, runs exactly `npm publish <escrowed-tarball> --provenance --access public`, performs exact registry readback, and returns structured command/readback fields. It does not create prepared/completed transitions, declare concurrency, download Actions/escrow records, select environments, or recover workflows.
- [hard] REQ-03: Unit fixtures reject second pack, changed bytes, source-directory publish, mismatched expected integrity/package/provenance, token use and incorrect registry readback. Early-publish guards, exact parent authentication, OIDC/environment permission wiring, `jit-v1.0.0-publication`, prepared/completed/Actions-410 recovery, and mutating-subjob/cross-workflow fixtures remain outside these pure interfaces.
- [hard] REQ-04: Completion proves public npm 1.0.0 is absent and no v1 tarball was retained; only MCP metadata, scripts/interfaces and unit fixtures land, not release-execution YAML.

## Notes

Blast radius: MCP metadata, pack/smoke/direct-publish scripts and interfaces, and unit fixtures. Release-execution workflow YAML and producing or publishing v1 bytes are outside scope.
